'''Amadaine 20 (June 28)'''

==Events==
* [[999 NE]] - [[Rand]] and the [[Aiel]] arrive at [[Cold Rocks Hold]]. They are attacked in the night by [[Trollocs]] and [[Draghkar]]. Rand decides to leave for [[Alcair Dal]] immediately, as the [[Shaido]] have already departed.
* [[999 NE]] - [[Egeanin]] releases [[Bethamin]].
